name: Datang Street Scene Set
description: The Datang Street series is a puzzle created based on the busy city of the Tang Dynasty. The rows of ancient buildings and bustling streets are full of traffic, vividly showing the life style of that era. This scene set includes scene accessories other than buildings, including bright lanterns, walking carriages, various pedestrians, pyrotechnic wonton stalls, etc. They can not only match the buildings of Datang Street, but also match other ancient buildings. Come and use your imagination to build your own ancient world!
